siteTitle: Gihan Bhathi — Design Engineer & Creative Technologist
heroHeadline: Crafting digital products with precision, code & soul.
heroBio: I am a design engineer blending modern front-end craftsmanship with clean aesthetics. Specializing in high-performance web applications, interactive design systems, and thoughtful digital experiences.

headline: Merging engineering rigor with timeless, human-centered design.
shortBio: With over 6 years of experience building modern web products, I live at the intersection of design, code, and user empathy.
story: My journey began with an obsession for how things feel on screen. Early on, I realized the most memorable software isn't just visually striking or technically complex—it is the subtle synergy between both. When motion is fluid, typography is intentional, and response times are instantaneous, software feels like an extension of thought.

Over the past six years, I have collaborated with venture-backed startups and established engineering teams to architect scalable front-end systems, establish comprehensive design tokens, and launch products used by tens of thousands of active users every day.

Today, I operate as an independent Design Engineer & Creative Technologist. I partner directly with founders, product leaders, and design teams to turn ambitious visions into robust, production-ready web applications.

workflow.title: Discovery & Architectural Blueprint
workflow.description: Every successful project starts with clarity. We dissect user personas, product goals, brand aesthetics, and technical constraints to establish a bulletproof roadmap.

workflow.title: High-Fidelity Design & Interaction Prototype
workflow.description: Translating ideas into crisp layouts in Figma with exact typography scales, responsive grids, and interactive prototypes that validate every gesture before writing code.

workflow.title: Clean Modular Development
workflow.description: Engineering your application with typed components, atomic design standards, and seamless Sanity CMS integration, ensuring peak rendering speeds and intuitive editorial control.

workflow.title: Polish, Audit & Zero-Downtime Launch
workflow.description: Deep performance profiling, 100/100 Lighthouse audits, cross-browser stress testing, SEO optimization, and smooth deployment to production edge networks.

degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science & Interaction
description: Comprehensive curriculum focused on algorithms, software architecture, human-computer interaction, visual interface design, and distributed systems. Recipient of the Annual Dean’s Award for Outstanding Technical Capstone.
Specialized training in building enterprise-grade multi-brand design tokens, fluid CSS/Canvas physics animations, and accessibility-first web components that meet strict WCAG AAA guidelines.
Deep validation of schema modeling, GROQ query optimization, real-time live preview setups, embedded Sanity Studio custom tools, and automated content migration pipelines.
In-depth exploration of App Router server components, streaming SSR, edge caching strategies, dynamic OG image generation, and modern front-end performance profiling.

title: Chronicle Design System
excerpt: A clean, modular design language and accessible React component library built for rapid cross-functional product development.
fullDescription: Chronicle is a production-tested design system engineered to bridge the gap between Figma design files and React engineering workflows. It provides over 80 atomic components, automated token synchronizers, and comprehensive documentation. Built with zero-runtime CSS variables, strict TypeScript types, and full keyboard navigation support.

title: Apex Telemetry & Analytics Dashboard
excerpt: High-throughput developer metrics dashboard featuring real-time event streaming and customizable visual widget canvases.
fullDescription: Apex is an ultra-fast developer observability console created for monitoring cloud infrastructure and microservices. Featuring smooth Canvas-based time-series charts, modular grid layouts, and sub-50ms query responses. Connected directly to Sanity CMS for editorial release notes and feature flags.

title: Prism AI Studio & Prompt Lab
excerpt: Interactive generative playground and prompt asset curator built for digital artists and creative directors.
fullDescription: Prism empowers creative teams to synthesize, compare, and organize generative AI visual experiments in one unified workspace. Includes side-by-side prompt diffing, high-resolution canvas zoom inspectors, tag clustering, and instant export pipelines to production media repositories.

title: Solfeggio Soundscapes
excerpt: Interactive audio-visual frequency synthesizer utilizing Web Audio synthesis and particle canvas dynamics.
fullDescription: An exploratory web experience exploring resonant harmonics, visual mathematics, and binaural audio. Solfeggio generates soothing real-time soundscapes based on natural frequencies while projecting responsive particle waves on a customized HTML5 canvas engine.

title: Monolith Editorial Commerce
excerpt: Headless luxury lifestyle storefront integrating editorial storytelling with instant cart transitions and Sanity CMS.
fullDescription: Monolith blends magazine-style digital editorial design with a performant e-commerce backend. Built using Next.js App Router and Sanity CMS, the platform delivers instantaneous page transitions, localized currencies, dynamic lookbooks, and an intuitive custom studio editor.

title: Verve Orbital Celestial Explorer
excerpt: 3D educational astrophysics simulator allowing students and stargazers to trace planetary orbits in real time.
fullDescription: Built in collaboration with science educators, Verve brings planetary physics to the browser. Users can adjust gravitational constants, inspect planetary textures, view historical celestial events, and inspect key data points inside an intuitive modal drawer.
